item.title: Malaysian Mandopop star DIOR 大颖 is bringing her 'Kampung Girl' world tour to Singapore in March 2026
item.description: Malaysian singer-songwriter DIOR 大颖 is set to make her overseas concert debut in Singapore on 28 March 2026 with the Kampung Girl World Tour Concert, happening at The Star Theatre. Following a lightning-fast sold-out solo show in Genting, DIOR is now taking her heartfelt music and kampung girl charm global.
